ring_paint_arm.mechanism: .hm-mark is position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:100% inside .hm, which is display:inline; position:relative. The containing block of an absolutely-positioned child of a MULTI-LINE or padded inline is engine-dependent and resolves to 0-9px; the mask's -100%/300% userSpaceOnUse window collapses with it and clips the ink.
